$comment: Dated aliases of sf-message-log for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20), installed on the element by the Smart base. Since 2.0.0 the element is sf-list-feed's heir: the feed sends sf-list-feed-*, and the former names follow. The former properties and methods (messages, setMessages, prependMessages, renderMessage, announceMessage, remove(id)) and the 1.0 entry fields (pending, author_name) are answered by index.js itself: they take entries the feed must read in its own spelling. The remove row is refused by the shim by design (mode component).
